expungeDeletedInbox.sql:
SELECT m.mail_id as mail_id, m.uid_domain as uid FROM mails m
      WHERE m.user_id = $1 AND m.sent = $2
        AND m.deleted = TRUE AND m.expunged = FALSE AND m.is_spam = FALSE AND m.draft = FALSE
        AND (
          EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM mail_mailbox_uid x
            WHERE x.user_id = m.user_id AND x.mail_id = m.mail_id
              AND (x.mailbox = $3 OR x.mailbox LIKE $4)
          )
          OR (
            m.message_id NOT LIKE $5
            AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM mail_mailbox_uid x
              WHERE x.user_id = m.user_id AND x.mail_id = m.mail_id
                AND x.mailbox NOT IN ($6, $7)
            )
          )

WITH expanded_mails AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
          mail_id, read, saved, date,
          jsonb_array_elements(
  COALESCE(to_address, '[]'::jsonb) ||
  COALESCE(cc_address, '[]'::jsonb) ||
  COALESCE(bcc_address, '[]'::jsonb) ||
  COALESCE(envelope_to, '[]'::jsonb)
)->>'address' as address
        FROM mails
        WHERE user_id = $1
          AND expunged = FALSE
          AND draft = FALSE
          AND is_spam = FALSE
          AND (to_address IS NOT NULL OR cc_address IS NOT NULL OR bcc_address IS NOT NULL OR envelope_to IS NOT NULL)
          
      )
      SELECT
        address,
        COUNT(*) as count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN read = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unread,
        SUM(CASE WHEN saved = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as saved_count,
        MAX(date) as latest
      FROM expanded_mails
      WHERE address IS NOT NULL
      AND lower(regexp_replace(address, '^.*@', '')) = ANY($2::text[])
      GROUP BY address
      ORDER BY latest DESC
